summary: Oracle filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a primary follow-on offering of 86,206,897 common shares at $116.00 per share, raising roughly $10.0 billion before $121.5 million in underwriting discounts, with net proceeds near $9.88 billion. Reference price was $130.67 on October 30, 2026, implying a discount of about 11.2%. BofA Securities is global coordinator, with Wells Fargo, Citi, BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, J.P. Morgan and others as book-runners. A separate but unlinked $10.0 billion senior notes offering runs concurrently; neither closing is conditioned on the other. Shares rank junior to the notes; closing expected November 4, 2026.
